questions.question: Choose the correct sentence with the past perfect tense.
options: She had finished her homework before the meeting started.
She finishes her homework before the meeting started.
She will have finished her homework before the meeting starts.
She has finished her homework before the meeting started.
questions.answer: She had finished her homework before the meeting started.

questions.question: Select the correct form of the present perfect tense for the sentence: 'I _____ this film before.'
Which option correctly uses comparatives to compare two things?
options: My brother is taller than me.
My brother is taller from me.
My brother is taller than I.
My brother is taller to me.
questions.answer: My brother is taller than me.

questions.question: Identify the correct conditional sentence type 3 (unreal past condition).
options: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I study harder, I will pass the exam.
If I had studied harder, I will pass the exam.
If I studied harder, I would pass the exam.
questions.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

questions.question: Choose the appropriate modal verb for giving advice: 'You should _____ more vegetables.'
Select the correct form: 'There _____ a lot of traffic on the roads during rush hour.'
Which sentence correctly uses gerunds or infinitives after the verb 'decide'?
Choose the correct linker to connect the sentences: 'He didn't go to the party. _____ , he watched a movie at home.'
Select the appropriate word to complete the sentence: 'The new restaurant is _____ the old one; the food is better and the service is faster.'
Which option correctly uses the present perfect continuous tense?
options: I have been living in London for five years.
I was living in London for five years.
I am living in London for five years.
I will be living in London for five years.
questions.answer: I have been living in London for five years.
